title: Semifields represented by a Dembowski--Ostrom matrix-space family
summary: Determine which invertible-matrix spaces and non-isotopic semifields arise from the specified Dembowski--Ostrom polynomial family.

formal_statement.body: Let $n=2m$ and consider the admissible Dembowski--Ostrom polynomials $$F_{r,\Lambda}(x)=x^{2^r}\operatorname{Tr}_m^n(\Lambda(x))$$ from the source, where $\Lambda$ is a linearized permutation satisfying its maximal-bent-component hypotheses. Determine whether this family represents more than one vector space of invertible symmetric matrices. If it does, classify all non-isotopic semifields represented by the resulting matrix spaces; otherwise prove uniqueness of the matrix-space type.

scope.domain: Dembowski--Ostrom polynomials, invertible symmetric-matrix spaces, and finite semifields
assumptions: Matrix-space and semifield equivalence use the source conventions
scope.unresolved_remainder: No inspected later work gives a complete matrix-space multiplicity result or classifies all non-isotopic semifields arising from the full source polynomial family.

progress.summary: Question 4 asks whether the polynomial family yields multiple invertible-matrix spaces and, if so, which non-isotopic semifields it specifies.
